title: Des Moines Register, obituary of Ronald E. Totosz (18 August 2004)
citation: Obituary, "RONALD E. TOTOSZ, Ankeny," Des Moines Register, Wednesday 18 August 2004, Metro section p. 7 col. 5, repeated identically on obituaries p. 25. newspapers.com images 130714050 and 131380041; permanent clippings 203981098 (p. 7) and 203981158 (p. 25). Records that he was born 10 October 1941 in Chicago, Illinois, died 12 August 2004, and worked 25 years as a bio tech at Iowa Methodist Hospital. Includes a later-life portrait photograph.
notes: Fixes his dates. The birth year makes him 22 or 23 during Larry’s tour, close to Larry’s own age. Note what it does not say: the obituary makes no mention of military service at all, which is common, and is why the 1962 enlistment list carries that part alone. Larry remembers Ron dying "about ten years ago"; the 2004 death is about twelve years earlier than that, recorded as a difference in the remembering rather than a problem with the identification. Located through the Des Moines Public Library newspaper index, which gave the exact section, page and column; the Register is the source, the index the route.
